page.layout: One column of index entries: Hebrew word at left, reference "p." with page numbers at right, in groups separated by blank lines. Running head above the column. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: רוש | pro veneno & re amarâ. | p. 157.

page.notes: The Hebrew entries are copied as printed, without vowel points. "רוונים" (the entry after ראש) is doubtful: [?] was not added because the letters are clear, but the word may be misprinted. The catchword "רפש" stands at the left foot, not at the right as the rules expect, so its position was kept as printed. The Latin gloss in the רוש line sits inline between the word and its reference, as printed. The numerals are printed in old-style forms and were copied as Arabic digits; the scan's "I" and "z" forms could be misread. The signature reads "Iiii 3" at the right foot. No page number is printed at the head.
